lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns across the mid-flank. A distinct cluster of approximately 8-10 high-luminance spots is visible in the lower-left quadrant, with spots becoming more sparsely distributed towards the upper-right section of the visible area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs. These vertical stripes serve as corridors for the spots, creating a grid-like appearance where the spots act as high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper-mid section of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and a distinct shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A single remora with a prominent white lateral stripe is attached to the mid-flank. Multiple yellow fish with dark vertical bars (pilot fish) are present in the foreground water column, with one partially occluding the lower-left portion of the shark's flank pattern.
